race.comment: CAT CALL (3) made it two wins from his last four when he led from barrier rise to take out a BM65 over 1000m here a fortnight ago. Not quite as effective at today's trip but he has placed three times from six attempts. Might look the winner at some stage. SEISMIC BOOM (6) returned to the winner's list with an authoritative performance over this distance at the Sunshine Coast recently. Drawn to get all the favours and she should be hard to stop when produced. HALFACHANCE (2) disappointed here two back but got back to form last start at Gatton in a good performance over 1400m. Back in trip today, but the drying surface should help and a he can feature in the finish. SWIFT DUKE (10) was solid on debut at this track and the rise to 1200m now looks ideal. Won't be far away.
